contexts.text: A Spirit has much more excellent sensitive faculties. AC 322.
The Sensitive, or Corporeal, is man's existere.
Everything sensitive relates to the sense of touch... For the Sensitive is nothing else than an external Perceptive; and the Perceptive is nothing else than an internal Sensitive. Explained.
He believes from this Sensitive, and not from doctrine...
All that Sensitive which appears in the body is properly of its spirit...
The Sensitive of man immediately after death. Explained.
The sensitive life of Spirits is twofold: real, and not real. Explained.
They would have no sensitive life.
That all the Sensitive of truth would be obliterated. Signified, Explained.
Hence man has... a sensitive perception of good.
The love in its sensitive life, and in its active life. Explained. DLW 407.
All the Perceptive and Sensitive is derived from (relation).
